meta.title: Cafe Social — Social gaming at partner cafés
meta.description: Loyalty, friends, and venue-locked games at partner cafés. Check in on site, earn perks, and play Word or Brawler — or from home with a subscription.

hero.title: Play where you belong.
hero.subtitle: Loyalty and social play at partner cafés — games when you're there, or at home with a subscription.

partnerStage.title: Where Cafe Social comes alive
partnerStage.subtitle: Games, challenges, and perks are tied to real venues — not a generic feed. We're growing the partner network; pilot venues lead the way.

checkIn.title: Check in on site
checkIn.body: We detect partner venues with geofencing. Scan a QR or enter a venue code while you're there — that unlocks games and venue challenges for your visit.

games.title: Word rooms & Brawler
games.body: Short word clue games — solo or with friends in a room. Or jump into Brawler: 1v1 arena battles with heroes and power-ups, tied to the café you're at.

loyalty.title: Perks, XP & friends
loyalty.body: Earn venue XP, climb tiers, unlock staff-redeemable perks. Add friends, see who's here, and stay in the loop with venue activity.

subscription.title: Play from home too
subscription.body: Away from cafés you still get loyalty and social features. A subscription lets you play Word and Brawler globally — no visit required.

games.title: Two ways to play
games.subtitle: Hover a card to flip between the vibe and the game mode — just like meeting the heroes before the match.

word.name: Word rooms
word.tagline: Clues, rounds, and café bragging rights
word.description: Multi-round clue games: solo practice or create/join a room with a code. Co-op or versus — perfect for the table while you wait.
word.backBody: Not the daily puzzle — this is the full lobby experience with friends at your venue.

brawler.name: Brawler
brawler.description: Pick a hero, queue for casual or ranked 1v1, or practice solo. Arena matches are tied to partner cafés — or global with a subscription.
brawler.backBody: Heroes, power-ups, and quick rounds built for mobile play between sips.

games.heroesSubtitle: A sample of Brawler heroes you'll unlock in the app.

values.title: More than a game on your phone

table.title: Built for the table
table.body: Short sessions while you wait or hang out — not an endless grind away from the people you're with.

venue.title: Rewards tied to the venue
venue.body: Perks and challenges belong to the café you're in. Staff redeem codes — clear rules, no lost punch cards.

social.title: Friends at the café
social.body: See who's here, invite a party, climb venue leaderboards. Social play that stays grounded in real places.

partners.title: Good for guests and cafés
partners.body: Repeat visits, longer dwell, measurable engagement — without aggressive ads plastered on every screen.

visitSteps.title: What an afternoon looks like
visitSteps.subtitle: No scripts — just a realistic flow at a partner café.

arrive.title: Walk in & check in
arrive.body: Location on, QR scanned. Games and venue challenges unlock for this visit.

play.title: Play a round
play.body: Word room with a friend or a quick Brawler match while your order arrives.

earn.title: Earn & redeem
earn.body: Complete a challenge, collect a perk code, show it to staff at the till.

return.title: Come back next week
return.body: Daily word, new challenges, and friends who remember your username.

partnerCta.title: Turn dwell time into loyalty
partnerCta.body: Cafe Social gives partner venues a digital layer: geofenced play, staff-redeemable perks, and analytics — without asking guests to install five different apps.

benefits.visits: Encourage repeat visits with challenges and daily rituals
benefits.brand: Keep the experience tied to your name and space
benefits.staff: Simple staff redemption — codes and QR, not paper cards
benefits.pilot: Start with a short pilot and clear success metrics

what.a: Cafe Social is a mobile app that connects guests and partner cafés through location-aware games, loyalty, and social features. When you're at a partner venue, you can check in, play Word or Brawler, earn XP, and redeem perks — all tied to that café.

free.a: Yes. You can download the app, create an account, and use loyalty and social features for free. Games unlock when you visit a partner café. An optional subscription lets you play from home without a visit.

unlock.a: Games need a venue check-in: scan the café's QR or enter a code while you're on site, with location enabled so we can confirm you're there. Away from partner venues, games stay locked unless you have a subscription.

partner.a: A partner café is a physical venue enrolled in Cafe Social. It has a geofence, staff tools for perk redemption, and optional challenges and offers you configure with us.

subscription.a: A subscription (Cafe Social Pro) lets you play Word and Brawler globally — not only when you're checked in at a venue. Loyalty and venue-specific perks still require visits.

stores.q: Where can I download the app?
stores.a: Cafe Social is coming soon to the App Store and Google Play. Join our partner pilot or check back here for store links when we launch.

download.title: Ready to play?
download.subtitle: Download Cafe Social and find a partner café near you — or partner with us to bring it to your venue.
